报告元数据.主营业务: 工业车辆研发制造，涵盖新能源叉车、智能物流装备及核心零部件
报告元数据.企业名称: 杭叉集团股份有限公司
报告元数据.报告名称: 杭叉集团股份有限公司2025年度环境、社会及公司治理（ESG）报告
报告元数据.报告页码/章节: 第3页 关于本报告；第5页 关于杭叉；第7页 关键ESG绩效

环境管理体系.值: 基于ISO14001:2015标准建立完整制度矩阵，截至报告期末已完成总部及10家控股子公司体系认证
环境管理体系.原文: Based on the framework of ISO14001:2015 standard, the Company has established a complete institutional matrix... By the end of the reporting period, the Company had completed the system certification of the headquarters and 10 controlled subsidiaries

碳管理体系建设.值: 依据ISO 14064-3:2019原则，由独立第三方对温室气体声明是否符合ISO 14064-1:2018进行核查；主导编制的国家标准《温室气体产品碳足迹量化方法与要求 工业车辆》通过专家初步评审
碳管理体系建设.原文: In accordance with the principles of ISO 14064-3:2019, an independent third-party verification was conducted to assess whether the greenhouse gas statement from the audited party complies with ISO 14064-1:2018. / the national standard Quantification Methods and Requirements for Product Carbon Footprint of Greenhouse Gases – Industrial Vehicles, for which Hangcha led the preparation, passed preliminary expert review.

碳总量.原文: According to the verification report, the Company's total greenhouse gas emissions in 2025 decreased by 48.37% compared with 2024.

碳排放强度.原文: the Company continuously reduces the energy consumption per unit of output value and the carbon emission intensity

碳排放抵消与同比变化.值: 2025年温室气体排放总量较2024年下降48.37%，主要由于2025年现场光伏发电被认定为绿电环境权益，按零碳排放计算
碳排放抵消与同比变化.原文: According to the verification report, the Company's total greenhouse gas emissions in 2025 decreased by 48.37% compared with 2024. This reduction was mainly attributable to the recognition of on-site photovoltaic power for 2025 as green power environmental credits that are calculated as zero carbon emissions.

范围一排放.原文: Scope 1 Greenhouse Gas Emissions: Stationary source emissions, Mobile source emissions, Industrial process emissions, Fugitive emissions

能源类型和强度.值: 主要能源包括电力、天然气、汽油和柴油；2025年清洁能源使用比例超过55.01%
能源类型和强度.原文: responsible for the comprehensive and efficient utilization of multiple energy resources such as electricity, natural gas, gasoline and diesel in the industrial park. / In 2025, we took the lead in making the utilization rate of clean energy exceed 55.01% in the production process.

节能目标与改造情况.值: 依托光伏发电节能项目降低碳排放；可再生能源装机容量15.76MW，清洁能源消费量700万千瓦时；新装RCO催化燃烧装置提升VOCs处理能力
节能目标与改造情况.原文: Renewable energy installed capacity of 15.76 MW; clean energy consumption of 7 million kWh / In 2025, the Company newly installed RCO catalytic combustion devices, greatly improving VOC treatment capacity.

供应商碳培训及考核情况.值: 2025年组织62场供应商交流与培训活动，全部向中小企业开放，提供技术、质量、可持续发展等方面专业指导
供应商碳培训及考核情况.原文: All of the 62 supplier exchange and training activities organized in 2025 are open to SMEs, providing them with professional guidance on technology, quality, sustainable development and other aspects

供应商碳披露及评价要求.值: 建立供应商评价体系，将可持续发展能力作为合作核心考量之一；要求供应商签署《廉洁承诺书》；将反不正当竞争要求纳入供应商尽职调查和年度评价
供应商碳披露及评价要求.原文: the Company has established a 'Supplier Evaluation System' / takes sustainable development capacity as one of the core considerations in cooperation / Before cooperation, suppliers are required to sign the Integrity Commitment Letter

供应商绿色采购标准.值: 在采购实践中强调资源效率优先，优先选择能减少废弃物、碳足迹和资源消耗的产品和服务；优先选择具有健全环境管理体系、符合道德和劳工规范、倡导社会责任的供应商
供应商绿色采购标准.原文: the Company underscores the principle of resource efficiency first, giving priority to products and services that can reduce waste, carbon footprint and resource consumption. / the Company gives priority to suppliers with sound environmental management systems, conformity to ethical and labor norms and advocacy of social responsibility

包装减量及回收情况.值: 钣金焊接公司推广可循环使用包装载具，定制专用金属循环托盘替代一次性木质托盘，每年可节省近20,000个一次性木质托盘
包装减量及回收情况.原文: customizes special metal circular pallets for internal repeated use, completely puts an end to the one-time consumption mode... nearly 20,000 disposable wooden pallets can be saved every year

循环经济链塑造.值: 废活性炭再生利用：委托第三方专业机构再生处理113.9吨废活性炭，每吨再生炭驱动3吨资源循环利用，每吨再生炭减少3.66吨CO₂当量排放，总碳减排416.874吨CO₂e；油漆污泥通过板框压滤减量处置，含水率从90%降至60%以下
循环经济链塑造.原文: the Company completed a total of 113.9t hazardous waste activated carbon regeneration... each ton of regenerated activated carbon drives 3 tons of resource recycling and reuse, with each ton of regenerated carbon helping reduce 3.66 tons of CO2 equivalent emissions. The Company's total carbon reduction reached 416.874 (113.9×3.66) tons of CO2e

绿色物流.值: 厂内运输车辆100%采用新能源叉车；厂外运输车辆90%达到国五及以上排放标准；班车仅采用新能源电动车；在专用物流通道设置环保监控设备实时采集运输车辆数据
绿色物流.原文: the Company adopted new energy forklift as in-plant transportation vehicles, with coverage ratio hitting 100%. For out-of-plant transportation vehicles, 90% of them met the emission standards of National V and above. For shuttle bus, the Company only adopted new-energy electric vehicle.

供应链碳风险传导影响评估.值: 建立供应链碳排放管理体系，定期监测和报告供应链碳排放；将供应链可持续发展纳入战略考量；建立物理风险、政策法规风险和技术风险的预警和响应机制
供应链碳风险传导影响评估.原文: Establish a supply chain carbon emission management system, monitor and report supply chain's carbon emissions at regular intervals / the Company incorporates supply chain risk identification into the comprehensive risk management system, establishes early warning and response mechanisms for physical risks, policy & regulatory risks and technical risks

交易所ESG披露指引符合性.原文: This report is prepared in accordance with the requirements of the Self-Regulatory Guidelines for Listed Companies on the Shanghai Stock Exchange No. 14 - Sustainable Development Report (For Trial Implementation) and Self-Regulatory Guidelines for Listed Companies on the Shanghai Stock Exchange No. 4 - Sustainable Development Report Preparation issued by the Shanghai Stock Exchange.

碳排放披露范围.原文: Scope 1 Greenhouse Gas Emissions: Stationary source emissions, Mobile source emissions, Industrial process emissions, Fugitive emissions / Scope 2 Greenhouse Gas Emissions / Total Greenhouse Gas Emissions

ESG评级结果及行业排名.原文: the Company actively participated in the EcoVadis Assessment and won the 'EcoVadis Rapid Progress Medal for Sustainable Development'. It also passed ESG assessment accreditation by its global key client Holcim
